headline: Four airstrikes hit Ansar Allah weapons depots and military vehicles at the Central Security Camp in al-Bayda, central Yemen
dek: Four airstrikes targeted weapons depots and military vehicles belonging to Yemen's Ansar Allah group at the Central Security Camp in al-Bayda province; the broadcaster did not identify who carried out the strikes and there was no immediate information on casualties or damage. Al-Bayda borders eight…
sources: Al-Jumhuriya TV (field sources) via Arab Times Online; Ansar Allah-affiliated media via Al Jazeera Nov 4 liveblog (03:42 GMT entry)
fault_line: Who is bombing al-Bayda -- and does the unidentified-strike pattern mean the coalition is striking without claiming it?

sections.what_happened: Four airstrikes targeted weapons depots and military vehicles belonging to Yemen's Ansar Allah group at the Central Security Camp in al-Bayda province; the broadcaster did not identify who carried out the strikes and there was no immediate information on casualties or damage. Al-Bayda borders eight other provinces and is mostly Ansar Allah-controlled; the strikes come amid the Yemeni government forces' 'Dawn of Yemen' operation (since Oct 5) to retake state institutions and Sanaa. Ansar Allah-affiliated media separately reported coalition air strikes in al-Bayda city (four strikes) plus coalition shelling in Ghamr district, Saada.
sections.what_verified: 1 declared family: Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA) liveblog relay of Ansar Allah-affiliated media. Arab Times / Al-Jumhuriya TV have NO declared tier in the registry -- reported with attribution only, never counted.
sections.what_disputed: Actor unidentified by both relays -- no coalition claim, no government claim, no Ansar Allah casualty claim. Same-count/same-place agreement may be one event double-reported, not two waves; do not present as eight strikes.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Arab Times Nov 4 10:03 +03 = 11:03 ): four airstrikes hit Ansar Allah weapons depots and military vehicles at the Central Security Camp in al-Bayda, central Yemen; actor unidentified, no casualties reported

totw_analysis: Our read: The fault line our audience is arguing over: Who is bombing al-Bayda -- and does the unidentified-strike pattern mean the coalition is striking without claiming it?
